commit.authority: leaderless OR single_writer positive generation + UUID replica + Hex16 incarnation
condition: absent no retained state; deleted requires version
version Hex32 bound to scope/schema/authority/full primary state
commit.effect_digest: Hex32 producer recomputed canonical normalized scope/authority/conditions/schema/observed/value; excludes transaction id
commit.writes: sorted; condition+atomic group evaluated under native storage commit exclusion, not application mutex

point: Existing version:1 protocol discriminator retained; state_version:Hex32|null CAS token only for single live/deleted state, absent/conflict null; all state/context/conflict siblings preserved.
retry: Compare durable effect fingerprint BEFORE re-evaluating conditions; original committed and rejected receipts retained until expiry; unknown/pending never definitive abort
scope: UUID tenant/database/collection/document; shard canonical full-u64 decimal; same shard only
security_release_blockers: P02 signed durable single-writer assignment/admission+commit fence
status_route: POST scoped /transactions/status with version,transaction_id,effect_digest,authority; authorize original scoped operation
